decision.explanation: Outcome is similar to C01 (excess_hall_adhesive). Ranking only the supplied references by COMPARISON.WELCH gives C01 2.984 dB, C04 7.479 dB, C03 7.697 dB, and C02 10.484 dB. The nearest C01 distance is within its calibrated 3.377 dB threshold, so the prescribed rule selects C01. The shared 5.3 Hz line, identical 68.03-microsecond autocorrelation lag, approximately 3.5 Hz envelope repetition, persistent 10 s time pattern, broad spectral contour, 4–8 kHz trough, and near-16 kHz feature support that decision. Q01's substantial 0.94 kHz cluster and altered band powers are real differences, but they do not overturn the thresholded gain-centered shape match. All reports have matching 10 s duration, 44.1 kHz sampling, Nyquist coverage to 22.05 kHz, and identical spectral resolution, so the observed frequency shifts are not attributable to differing sampling axes or resolution. Absolute FS levels are reported but not treated as calibrated physical amplitudes because acquisition gain is unknown.
